prompts.cafe:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Asset type: one standalone wide landscape introductory illustration for a reinforcement-learning Jupyter notebook, approximately 16:9.
Use the supplied image as a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Create the dessert-cafe overview described below, not a reproduction of the reference's scene.
Style: charming clean black monoline cartoon on a pure white background; thick smooth rounded black outlines, sparse medium-grey secondary strokes, simple smiling faces and chef hats like the reference. Flat 2D vector-like drawing. Lots of white space. No shading, gradients, coloured panels, textures, decorative colour or realistic rendering.
Composition: cafe scene on the left, a simple demand-pattern plot on the right. A friendly chef and a friendly robot barista behind a minimally drawn counter, all strictly black/white/grey. EXACTLY TWO desserts total: ONE chewy cookie on a plate, highlighted in bright BLUE (#008bff), and ONE triangular pistachio cake slice on a plate, highlighted in bright PINK (#ff268d). Do not add other food, duplicate desserts, extra coloured props or coloured characters.
Selective colour is essential: the blue cookie and its blue demand curve are one matching pair; the pink cake and its pink demand curve are the other matching pair. Everything else black/white/grey. Do not use food's natural brown or green colours.
Plot: thin grey axes, two smooth curves only. The pink Cake curve rises early, peaks around early afternoon and then declines. The blue Cookie curve stays lower in the morning, rises later, peaks in late afternoon, and remains elevated near closing. The curves cross once around mid-afternoon. This is a qualitative schematic, not quantitative experimental data; no numerical y-axis ticks. Match each curve's colour exactly to its dessert. Plot title exactly "Demand pattern (schematic)"; horizontal axis label "Hour"; endpoints "10:00" and "18:00". Direct labels "1 Cookie" in blue and "2 Cake" in pink near their respective curves. Beside the dessert plates use small ordered callouts "1 Cookie" and "2 Cake" in the same respective colour. Those identify the same two items, not extra steps.
Top title exactly "Dessert cafe", in clean black lettering. A single modest black caption at the bottom: "Prepare now. Sell next hour."
Keep the overall figure concise and visually led, not a dense infographic. No observe/act/reward cards, no legend boxes, no neural-network diagrams, no long prose. All labels must be readable and spelled correctly. Final output must be a single completed illustration, not a collage of alternate designs.
